INSERT INTO app.DashboardCard
(
    CodSucursala,
    Luna,
    Anul,
    Banca,
    NumarSalariati,
    CreatedDate
)

SELECT
    @CodSucursala,
    @Luna,
    @Anul,
    'BCR',
    COUNT(DISTINCT cl.Marca),
    SYSDATETIMEOFFSET()

FROM app.CalculLichidare cl

INNER JOIN app.CardBCR b
    ON b.Marca = cl.Marca
    and b.Valid = 1

WHERE cl.CodSucursala=@CodSucursala
  AND cl.Luna=@Luna
  AND cl.Anul=@Anul

ActionParameters.Name: SqlQuery
ActionParameters.Value:
INSERT INTO app.DashBoardCard
(
    CodSucursala,
    Luna,
    Anul,
    Banca,
    NumarSalariati,
    CreatedDate
)

SELECT
    @CodSucursala,
    @Luna,
    @Anul,
    'CASH',
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.Marca),
    SYSDATETIMEOFFSET()

FROM app.Salariat s

WHERE s.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala and s.Anul= @Anul and s.Luna = @Luna

  AND NOT EXISTS
      (SELECT 1 FROM app.CardBCR b WHERE b.Marca = s.Marca and b.Valid = 1)

  AND NOT EXISTS
      (SELECT 1 FROM app.CardBRD b WHERE b.Marca = s.Marca and b.Valid = 1)

  AND NOT EXISTS
      (SELECT 1 FROM app.CardBT b WHERE b.Marca = s.Marca and b.Valid = 1)

  AND NOT EXISTS
      (SELECT 1 FROM app.CardCEC b WHERE b.Marca = s.Marca and b.Valid = 1)

  AND NOT EXISTS
      (SELECT 1 FROM app.CardING b WHERE b.Marca = s.Marca and b.Valid = 1)

  AND NOT EXISTS
      (SELECT 1 FROM app.CardEXM b WHERE b.Marca = s.Marca and b.Valid = 1)

  AND NOT EXISTS
      (SELECT 1 FROM app.CardRZB b WHERE b.Marca = s.Marca and b.Valid = 1)

  AND NOT EXISTS
      (SELECT 1 FROM app.CardUNI b WHERE b.Marca = s.Marca and b.Valid = 1);
